children: RNS Number : 5770V  Onward Homes Limited  21 September 2026
Publication of annual report and financial statements of Onward Homes Limited for the year ended 31 March 2026

Onward Homes Limited (OHL) is the charitable registered provider of social housing within the Onward Group. Onward Group Limited (OGL) is the parent entity in the Onward Group and is a non-charitable registered provider of social housing.
The annual report and financial statements of both entities are published today and are available for viewing on Onward's website.

OHL has made a net surplus before tax for the year of £21.2m (2025: £14.2m), a year-on-year increase of £7.0m mainly driven by lower repair costs and surpluses from our portfolio management programme. Underlying this, operating surplus of £34.0m (2025: £25.8m) has also increased by £8.2m versus the prior year.
OHL ended the financial year with cash and cash equivalents of £17.2m (2025: £15.8m). The increased cash position is a result of funding ahead of anticipated spend on our development programme.

The consolidated group has made a net surplus before tax for the year of £19.3m (2025: £13.3m). Underlying this, operating surplus of £33.8m (2025: £26.5m) has increased by £7.3m versus the prior year.
